subject: Hollis Medical — Exec Workshop: finalizing onsite schedule & venue logistics
messages:
From: Jamie O'Neal <j.oneal@hollismed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Eric Morales <emorales@hollismed.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Exec Workshop — onsite dates

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We'd like to lock in an in-person executive workshop the week of June 22 in San Francisco. Primary ask: two half-day sessions (Day 1: product strategy & demo; Day 2: ops & migration runbook). Our execs are flexible but prefer morning windows (09:30–13:00 PT).

Questions for you:
- Can Redwood provide AV (projector, local laptop hookup) and an AV tech on-site?
- Do you have a preferred venue or should we use Hollis HQ conference center?
- Any travel windows or pre-flight arrival you recommend for the Redwood team?

Attendees (tentative): Jamie O'Neal (Hollis), Eric Morales (Hollis), Caroline Wu (Hollis CTO), Irene — can you confirm Redwood leads?

Thanks — looking to finalize by EOD Monday so we can send calendar holds.

Best,
Jamie O'Neal
Head of Partnerships, Hollis Medical
Attachments: Hollis-prelim-constraints.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jamie O'Neal <j.oneal@hollismed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Exec Workshop — onsite dates

Hi Jamie — great to hear. Redwood leads: Irene Choi (Eng Partnerships), Karthik Iyer (Customer Success), Sean Gallagher (Solutions). We can cover AV and bring one of our engineers for the demo.

Draft plan:
- June 22, morning (09:30–13:00 PT): product strategy & live demo
- June 23, morning (09:30–13:00 PT): ops, runbook, and migration checklist

I attached a draft agenda (Redwood-Exec-Agenda-v1.docx) and a quick venue map request form. Can you confirm Hollis HQ room capacity (is 30 pax ok?) and whether security badges will be required for external guests?

I'll loop in Sean for venue ops and Karthik for success prep.

Thanks,
Irene

30 pax is fine. Hollis HQ requires visitor badges and a list of names 48 hours prior. AV note: we can provide basic projector and room mics; we'd prefer Redwood bring their own demo laptop and dongles. Also: can Redwood confirm whether you need dedicated network/VPN access for the demo firewall exceptions? Our security team will need a short questionnaire.

I can send the visitor badge form and a site map; attaching Hollis-MAP.pdf.

—Eric

GlobalVenueOps, can you confirm availability for a technician on June 22 morning (setup 08:00, teardown 14:00) and whether you support short-run dedicated VLANs for demo laptops? If VLAN not possible, we'll use an isolated hotspot.

Action items:
- GVO: confirm AV tech + equipment list
- Hollis: final visitors list by Tue 6/15 09:00 PT

All — thanks. Confirming:
- Dates: June 22 & 23 (09:30–13:00 PT)
- Venue: Hollis HQ, Conf Center A (30 pax)
- GVO to provide AV tech and standard projector; Redwood will bring demo laptop
- Hollis to provide visitor badges list by 6/15

I've attached the current floor plan (GVO-floorplan-3A.png) and the agenda. I'll send calendar holds once we receive the final attendees list.

Next call: Mon 6/15 10:00 PT to run through logistics with Hollis security and GVO.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Eng Partnerships, Redwood Inference
